title: Anthropic CEO Amodei admits "there's a huge uncertainty in what's going to happen next year" days before a record IPO
snippet: Days before what could be the largest IPO in history, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called buying compute 'the deepest business dilemma' his company faces. Anthropic's commitments now total nearly $901 billion, and it's still far from clear whether future revenue will justify those costs. The planned IPO is largely meant to serve as a financial buffer against that uncertainty. title: ‘I hope this email finds you’: Microsoft declares outage over as the world digs out of its inbox
snippet: Microsoft says it has restored Microsoft 365 service after an outage cut off email for governments, hospitals, courts and businesses in more than 70 countries. The company traced the problem to an earlier network capacity upgrade and says it will publish a preliminary post-incident report within two business days. Read More

title: Louisiana AG calls CFTC chair an ‘obsequious standard bearer’ for prediction markets following agency lawsuit
snippet: The CFTC sued Louisiana Friday to block a state judge's order banning 31 prediction markets, including Kalshi and Polymarket, in the state.

title: Synopsys sees AI accelerating EDA as chip-specific models divide work
snippet: Synopsys chief product development officer Shankar Krishnamoorthy said AI will accelerate the electronic design automation (EDA) industry as the company works with OpenAI to develop semiconductor-specific models, while maintaining support for both frontier and open-weight models to preserve platform neutrality.
